subject: Post-demo: payment route decision & security dependencies
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harris <olivia@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: payment route decision & security dependencies

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement can pick a path quickly:

Key recap:
- Helix is evaluating Redwood to power clinical note summarization (low-latency inference) across two internal apps.
- Main procurement questions: PO vs. corporate card vs. onboarding via the cloud marketplace.
- Security gating: SOC 2 Type II report, signed DPA, and a few outstanding items on your security questionnaire.

What we can provide this week:
- SOC2_Summary.pdf (summary of scope + date of latest Type II report) [attachment stub]
- Draft DPA for review (redwood-dpa-draft.docx) [attachment stub]
- Completed security questionnaire: we can fill Helix’s template if you share it or we can provide our standard questionnaire answers.

Proposed next steps / asks for procurement:
1) Confirm preferred payment route (PO / card / marketplace). If PO, please send the Helix PO template and target payment terms.
2) Procurement timeline: target milestone for PO signature or card pilot date.
3) Security gating: please call out any MUST-HAVE SOC2 evidence items beyond the summary we attached (e.g., encryption details, penetration test reports, access logs retention).
4) Schedule a short procurement sync — we’re available Fri 5/23 11:00 PT, or Mon 5/26 morning.

Optional commercial unblock: if procurement needs 2–4 weeks to finalize PO, we can offer a short pilot on card with a one-page commercial addendum and a $20k credit to move things forward while DPA signature is in flight. If you prefer marketplace, note that marketplace onboarding is typically 4–6 weeks (depends on required security attestation).

If you share the specific security questionnaire or PO template, we’ll start filling and loop legal for the DPA.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0172

From: Olivia Harris <olivia@helixhealth.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procure@helixhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: payment route decision & security dependencies

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the clear recap. High level from procurement (initial scan):
- Preferred flow: PO is preferred for anything > $25k.
- Marketplace: acceptable only if pricing is demonstrably better and if Redwood can pass our onboarding checklist; timeline is generally longer.
- Card: acceptable for pilots under $25k or internal POs for single teams.

Security gating:
- We require a SOC2 Type II report (redacted ok) and a signed DPA.
- We also have a security questionnaire (attached: Helix_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — the biggest items to validate are data retention and encryption-in-transit/key management.

I attached our procurement template (Helix_PO_Template.pdf) to speed the PO path. If Redwood can provide the SOC2 Type II report and a drafted DPA within two business days, procurement will start routing the PO.

We’ve penciled in a procurement call Friday 5/23 at 11:00 PT to walk through the checklist. Can you confirm?

Best,
Olivia Harris
Head of Procurement
Helix Health
olivia@helixhealth.ai

[attachment: Helix_PO_Template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: payment route decision & security dependencies

Lauren / Marissa —

Quick operational notes after reviewing Helix’s asks and our readiness:
- SOC2: We have the latest SOC2 Type II report. I’ll request the secure sharing link from security; we can deliver a redacted PDF within 48 hours.
- DPA: Legal has approved the standard Redwood DPA; I attached the draft we usually send (redwood-dpa-draft.docx). We should be able to turn around Helix’s redlines within 3 business days.
- Marketplace onboarding: requires a separate enablement flow (onboarding-marketplace-checklist.md) and typically takes 4–6 weeks given attestation steps.

Commercial unblock options (recommendation):
1) Fast PO path: provide SOC2 + DPA now and request PO submission.
2) Short-term pilot: offer card-based pilot (<= $25k) with a $20k credit and 30–60 day evaluation to prove value while legal finalizes DPA. This is faster and removes an immediate procurement blocker.
3) If they insist on marketplace, we should set expectations around the 4–6 week timeline and consider offering staging/demo access to reduce time to value.

Ask: do you approve offering the $20k pilot credit and commercial addendum as an interim path? If yes I’ll draft the one-page addendum and route to Sales Ops for sign-off.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions 
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

[attachment: onboarding-marketplace-checklist.md (md)]
